slides.title: Dollars per point
head: Contract
Per point
Per tick
slides.text: One tick = **0.25** points. Micros are **one tenth** of the full contract.

points.t: Decide the dollars first, then the contracts.
Same market, a tenth of the risk.

points.b: NQ moves more points than ES
points.t: The same stop in points is not the same risk.

slides.title: Know the point value before you click.
slides.text: Points × $ per point × contracts = **the money on the line**.

post.instagram:
The same 10-point move is $500 on one ES, $50 on one MES, $200 on one NQ and $20 on one MNQ. Risk = stop in points × $ per point × contracts. Contract specs from CME Group.
